names.note: saint.gr prints the name in Latin letters and not in Greek, both in its line for 1 Αυγούστου, «Άγιος Ethelwald», and in its page heading, «Αγιος Ethelwald». No Greek form of it appears on either, and none is supplied here.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 1ης Αυγούστου — «Άγιος Ethelwald»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 1 Αυγούστου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The whole notice is one sentence: «Δεν έχουμε λεπτομέρειες για τον βίο του Αγγλοσάξωνα Αγίου» — we have no details of the life of this Anglo-Saxon saint. So there is no year, no place, no rank, no office, no hymn and no account of anything he did, and `types` is left empty because the page states no rank at all. The spelling is the page's own, in Latin letters inside a Greek listing, and is kept as printed. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
